extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH documentation previews at the source hue/chroma. They are not deployed CSS palette tokens. Component specimens bind to existing --ui-* properties and use observed-value fallbacks; empty values do not assert league results.

shadows.name: interactive-surface-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover emphasis for linked data surfaces.

shadows.name: persistent-dock
shadows.purpose: Separates the dock from scrolling content.

motion.name: control-route-disclosure
motion.purpose: Control color transitions and route/disclosure appearance.

motion.name: sorted-row
motion.purpose: Visible row movement after user sorting.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Solid blue action used for loading more results and calculator actions.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Quiet outlined control with blue-wash hover feedback.
components.css: .ds-secondary{background:var(--ui-surface, #fff);color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80);border:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec);border-radius:var(--ui-control-radius,8px);padding:9px 14px;min-height:40px;font:600 12px/1.25 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms,color 180ms,border-color 180ms,transform 150ms}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--ui-blue-soft, #eaf0ff);color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);border-color:#b6c9f0}.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;animation:none;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Selected filter
components.description: A pressed filter uses the same royal blue as primary navigation.
components.css: .ds-filter{background:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);border-radius:var(--ui-control-radius,8px);padding:9px 14px;min-height:40px;font:600 12px/1.25 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 150ms}.ds-filter:hover{background:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc)}.ds-filter:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filter{transition:none;animation:none;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Outlined search; the phone text size avoids automatic input zoom.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" aria-label="Search players" placeholder="Search players…">
components.css: .ds-search{font:400 14px/1.4 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--ui-ink, #16243b);background:var(--ui-surface, #fff);border:1px solid #b8c5d6;border-radius:var(--ui-control-radius,8px);min-height:42px;padding:9px 12px;width:240px;max-width:100%;caret-color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc)}.ds-search::placeholder{color:#63748a;opacity:1}.ds-search:hover{cursor:text}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:699px){.ds-search{font-size:16px;min-height:44px;width:100%}}

components.name: Desktop navigation
components.description: Rail link states, using the deployed Tabler paths.
components.html: HomeTeamsRecords
components.css: .ds-rail{width:224px;max-width:100%;padding:26px 16px 16px;background:var(--ui-navy, #101d35);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.ds-rail a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;color:#c4d1e7;text-decoration:none;font:500 13px/1.25 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);transition:background-color 180ms,color 180ms}.ds-rail a[aria-current=page]{background:#24447b;color:#fff;font-weight:600}.ds-rail a:hover{background:#1c3153;color:#fff}.ds-rail a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-rail a{transition:none;animation:none;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Mobile navigation dock
components.description: An in-flow preview of the persistent six-destination safe-area dock.
components.html: HomeTeamsRecordsPlayersStreaksMore
components.css: .ds-dock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));min-height:76px;gap:2px;padding:8px max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));background:var(--ui-surface, #fff);border-top:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec);box-shadow:0 -4px 20px rgb(22 36 59 / .04)}.ds-dock a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:56px;padding:4px 0;border-radius:8px;color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80);text-decoration:none;font:500 11px/1.1 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);transition:background-color 180ms,color 180ms,transform 150ms}.ds-dock a>span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:38px;height:27px;border-radius:7px}.ds-dock a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);font-weight:700}.ds-dock a[aria-current=page]>span{background:var(--ui-blue-soft, #eaf0ff)}.ds-dock a:hover{cursor:pointer}.ds-dock a:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-dock a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dock a{transition:none;animation:none;transform:none!important}}

components.name: Record card
components.description: Unbound record specimen; the dash is not a fabricated league performance.
components.html: Career points—Open the full leaderboard
components.css: .ds-record-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:20px;background:var(--ui-surface, #fff);color:var(--ui-ink, #16243b);border:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec);border-radius:var(--ui-radius,14px);text-decoration:none;box-shadow:none}.ds-record-label{font:600 11px/1.5 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);letter-spacing:.025em;color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80)}.ds-record-value{font:700 34px/1.1 var(--ui-display, 'Barlow Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.015em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-record-note{font:500 12px/1.5 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80)}@media(hover:hover){.ds-record-card:hover{border-color:#91afe6;background:#fbfcff;box-shadow:var(--ui-shadow,0 6px 20px rgb(22 36 59 / .06))}}.ds-record-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:699px){.ds-record-card{padding:14px}}

components.name: Franchise tabs
components.description: Flat underlined navigation preserves all seven franchise destinations.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec);scrollbar-width:thin}.ds-tabs button{flex:none;white-space:nowrap;padding:12px 0;min-height:48px;background:transparent;color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80);border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;border-radius:0;font:600 12px/1.25 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);border-bottom-color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc)}.ds-tabs button:hover{cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:699px){.ds-tabs{gap:20px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-tabs button:active{transform:scale(.97)}}

components.name: Record table
components.description: Aligned statistics with a fixed identity and local horizontal scroll; illustrative empty row only.
components.css: .ds-table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec);border-radius:12px;background:var(--ui-surface, #fff)}.ds-table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:470px;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ui-ink, #16243b)}.ds-table th{height:44px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--ui-soft, #f7f9fc);color:var(--ui-muted, #596a80);font:600 11px/1.4 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);letter-spacing:.025em;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec)}.ds-table td{height:54px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--ui-surface, #fff);font:400 13px/1.4 var(--ui-font, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf3}.ds-table th:first-child,.ds-table td:first-child{position:sticky;left:0;text-align:left;width:188px;border-right:1px solid var(--ui-line, #dce3ec)}.ds-table a{color:var(--ui-blue, #2459cc);text-decoration:none}.ds-table tr:hover td{background:#eff4fd}.ds-table a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #487eeb;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:699px){.ds-table td{height:56px;font-size:12px}.ds-table th:first-child,.ds-table td:first-child{width:142px}}

narrative.overview:
The Professional Broadcast Scorebook makes a dense league archive feel composed and immediate. Cool silver grounds and white surfaces organize the statistics; navy navigation anchors the application, while royal blue identifies actions and selected views. Barlow gives names, controls and notes a clear sporting voice. Barlow Condensed gives major titles and numerical records a stronger vertical presence.

The interface keeps original franchise portraits and the approved app icon as its identity. Historical records remain stable and connected to their details. Mobile layouts preserve those connections through a persistent dock, early franchise tabs and locally scrolling tables. Motion acknowledges an action or a genuinely changed live score; it does not turn archived results into a performance.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, readable statistics with tabular numerals.
One consistent interaction accent across every section.
Flat data surfaces, precise dividers and restrained hover depth.
Franchise identity, player imagery and earned championship accents.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use royal blue for navigation, selection and exploration. Keep win, loss and championship colors tied to their stated meaning.

rules.name: The Readable Metadata Rule
rules.body: Keep functional labels at least 11px. Use condensed type for major titles and values, and Barlow for compact names and explanatory text.

rules.name: The Flat List Rule
rules.body: Use one boundary around repeated records and separators between internal rows. Do not give every row its own rounded card.

dos: Do preserve the supplied franchise portraits and app icon.
Do keep every statistical value connected to its existing detail route.
Do keep frozen identity rows and scrolling statistical rows the same height.
Do use equal width, height and flex basis for circular profile portraits.
Do give phone inputs 16px text and retain visible keyboard focus.
Do respect safe areas, browser history, restored filters and scroll position.
Do animate changed live values and user-driven transitions only when reduced motion is not requested.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, glass panels or rainbow category borders.
Don't use white or pale text on the pale data surfaces.
Don't shrink metadata below the established 11px floor to force it into a column.
Don't animate static historical numbers or replace authentic unavailable states with invented data.
Don't hide columns, links or filters to make a phone layout fit.
Don't stretch franchise portraits or crop the existing app icon into a new identity.
